scopedChange: Direct source local callable/capture binding under source-bindings/v11 through the existing skeleton, six annotation roles, argument binder and typed material projection. Python signatures remain unchanged.

independentReviews.finding: A resolved local guard call inside an if was suspected to become unconditional.
independentReviews.disposition: Refuted. The proof requires an unconditional definition, not an unconditional call. The original skeleton retains the call in its branch; a new source-assisted constant-false regression compiles no call. Index resolution supplies identity only, not execution. Existing loop/try/with regions are retained.

independentReviews.finding: An unannotated capture stays value while a selected local binding may be annotated principal, suspected to bypass type completeness.
independentReviews.disposition: Refuted as an accepted typed/checked result. Python proves capture identity, not a principal role. Like ordinary source parameters, an unannotated capture remains an unknown value. The new actual projection regression reproduces this draft and the existing semantic checker reports semantic-argument-unbound for caller principal/helper value. This distinction between local syntactic completeness and typed/whole-answer acceptance remains explicit; no new interaction gate or inferred role was added.

primaryAdditionalCounterexamples: Owned yield cannot execute its body as an ordinary synchronous helper.
Pattern binding or another closure's nonlocal declaration does not prove an outer parameter cell stable.
A context role cannot erase a current named lexical callable gap.
Reading an escaped local callable body does not prove invocation/capture adoption.
An implicit capture cannot be passed as a new Python keyword.
Source-assisted rejecting helper adoption precedes a following write; swapped capture and changed source withdraw it.
